order_definition: Design-stage dominance order >=_T over candidate architectures, defined purely on the 22 frozen axis lattices and the hard invariants H1-H8, with no reference to any existing design. For each axis AX-k a frozen, totally ordered ladder of typed guarantee ranks L_k is fixed BEFORE any candidate is examined (see axis_lattices). rank_k(X) is the highest rung of L_k for which independently re-checkable evidence exists for candidate X (H8: recompute-and-compare, never a declared root); absent such evidence the axis is typed UNKNOWN (H2), never estimated. Definition: A >=_T B iff (i) for EVERY axis k in {AX-01..AX-22}, rank_k(A) and rank_k(B) are both KNOWN and rank_k(A) >= rank_k(B) in L_k; and (ii) no axis is INCOMPARABLE between A and B. Strict dominance A >_T B additionally requires at least one axis k where the gap satisfies that axis's pre-registered delta_rule (>= 1 full rank, class-level for AX-17/18). The order is strictly NON-COMPENSATORY: comparison is the per-axis product order only — a strict advantage on any number of axes NEVER offsets a strict deficit on even one axis; there is no weighting, no summation, no averaging, no score, and no aggregate object anywhere in the instrument (compensation is structurally impossible because no field exists to hold it, per verdict_schema). Consequences: if A is strictly better on some axes and strictly worse on others, A and B are INCOMPARABLE under >=_T (see incomparable_rule: synthesis obligation, never a coin-flip). If any axis of either candidate is UNKNOWN, no >=_T, TIE, or equality verdict may issue on the pair (see unknown_rule); UNKNOWN blocks, fail-closed (H3). Rank assignment is itself a trusted derivation: pure, deterministic, from frozen evidence artifacts, offline re-verifiable by third parties (H5, H8); an assessor's unverifiable claim of a rank is not a rank. Equality on an axis (TIE) requires both ranks KNOWN and equal — UNKNOWN never upgrades to TIE or pass (H2). This order is total in type but partial in fact: incomparability and unknownness are first-class outcomes, and the tournament may only conclude via the termination_rule, never by exhausting comparisons.

rank_levels: R1 unverified-assertion: legal conclusions emitted without checkable justification
R2 recorded-justification: rule applications and authorities recorded per conclusion, but not machine-checked
R3 machine-checked-derivation: every conclusion machine-checked against a formalized admitted rule base; unformalizable questions typed UNKNOWN

R4 defeater-sensitive-checked: machine-checked derivations with explicit defeasibility — exceptions, priority orders, and defeaters are typed objects searched over the admitted base; an undischarged potential defeater blocks the conclusion

R5 proof-carrying-defeater-closed: every answer carries an offline re-checkable proof object including a certified exhaustive defeater search over the admitted base; absence-of-defeater is itself certified or the answer is typed UNKNOWN
axis_lattices.delta_rule: Strict gap iff rank_A >= rank_B + 1 on this frozen ladder. A rank counts only when its verification artifacts are independently recomputable (H8); a claimed but non-recomputable rank scores UNKNOWN, never the claim.

rank_levels: R1 implicit-planning: decomposition ad hoc, plan never reified
R2 declared-plan: steps and ordering explicitly declared as data, completeness unchecked
R3 contract-typed-plan: every step carries machine-checked pre/postconditions; local step soundness enforced
R4 completeness-verified-plan: machine check that the composed postconditions entail the declared goal; any entailment gap surfaces as a typed UNKNOWN obligation, never silently absorbed
R5 certified-plan-calculus: plans are objects of a verified calculus; goal entailment, gap-freedom, and step soundness proven, with the proof offline re-checkable
axis_lattices.delta_rule: Strict gap iff rank_A >= rank_B + 1 on this frozen ladder; ranks assigned only from independently re-verifiable plan artifacts and checkers (H8), else UNKNOWN.

rank_levels: R1 uncoordinated: concurrent agents with implicit or no dependency control
R2 static-orchestration: fixed dependency graph, no declared arbitration semantics; conflicts resolved ad hoc
R3 explicit-dependency-and-arbitration: dependency graph and arbitration rules are declared typed objects, enforced at runtime; conflicting writes structurally routed to the arbiter
R4 verified-protocol: coordination protocol machine-checked to exclude deadlock, lost-update, and unarbitrated-conflict classes under the declared operating model; arbitration deterministic (H5)
R5 certified-coordination: protocol proofs offline re-checkable and every arbitration decision certificate-carrying and replayable (H6,H8)
axis_lattices.delta_rule: Strict gap iff rank_A >= rank_B + 1 on this frozen ladder; protocol-level ranks (R4,R5) require the exclusion proof itself to be independently re-checkable, else UNKNOWN.

rank_levels: R1 unconstrained-retrieval: source choice by similarity/heuristic, behavior varies with corpus size
R2 declared-source-policy: admission and selection policy stated but not enforced by the mechanism

R3 enforced-typed-admission: a source enters only through a typed, policy-checked admission act; selection operates over the admitted set only, making grounding corpus-size-independent by construction (H4)
R4 coverage-accounted-grounding: every claim is grounded to admitted sources with explicit machine-checked accounting of what was searched and what was not; an ungrounded claim is typed UNKNOWN (H2)
R5 certified-grounding: the grounding derivation is proof-carrying and offline re-verifiable against the frozen admitted corpus with zero producer trust (H8)
axis_lattices.delta_rule: Strict gap iff rank_A >= rank_B + 1 on this frozen ladder; R3+ requires demonstrating the enforcement is structural (bypass impossible), not procedural, else the lower rank applies.

rank_levels: R1 unvalidated-citation: citations emitted unchecked
R2 existence-checked: cited authority verified to exist and resolve; format validated
R3 support-checked: the cited pinpoint text is machine-verified to be present and to be the recorded basis of the proposition
R4 authority-state-checked: validity, hierarchy, and subsequent treatment (repealed/overruled/amended) machine-checked against the admitted authority state at the relevant legal time
R5 certificate-carrying-citation: every citation carries an offline re-checkable certificate binding proposition, pinpoint source, and authority status at a stated legal time (H5,H8)
axis_lattices.delta_rule: Strict gap iff rank_A >= rank_B + 1 on this frozen ladder; a rank applies only if the check covers ALL emitted citations (a sampled or partial check scores at most one rank below), unknown coverage scores UNKNOWN.

rank_levels: R1 no-provenance: artifacts carry no origin record
R2 free-form-logs: origins recoverable, if at all, from unstructured logs
R3 structured-provenance: every artifact carries typed provenance records (inputs, transformation, agent) as first-class data
R4 complete-cryptographic-lineage: every transformation hash-chained end-to-end; an artifact without complete lineage is inadmissible by construction (H3)
R5 recompute-and-compare-offline-verifiable: a third party re-derives every artifact from recorded inputs and compares, with zero producer trust (H8)
axis_lattices.delta_rule: Strict gap iff rank_A >= rank_B + 1 on this frozen ladder; 'complete' at R4/R5 means no admissible artifact class is exempt — a single exempt class caps the rank at R3.

rank_levels: R1 stateless: no matter context survives a request
R2 unstructured-memory: persistent but untyped context; retrieval heuristic
R3 canonical-matter-state: single-seat, single-writer typed matter record with capability closure (H4); reads deterministic
R4 provenance-carrying-institutional-memory: memory entries admitted only through validation, each carrying provenance; retrieval deterministic and replayable (H5)

R5 reflective-certified-memory: memory writes are all-or-nothing accountable state transitions (H6) and reflective updates (memory about the system's own performance) are themselves verified and offline replayable
axis_lattices.delta_rule: Strict gap iff rank_A >= rank_B + 1 on this frozen ladder; R3+ requires evidence that the single-writer property is structurally enforced, not conventionally observed.

rank_levels: R1 atemporal: implicit current-snapshot semantics only
R2 timestamped-sources: temporal metadata stored but not used in evaluation
R3 explicit-legal-time-model: validity intervals are typed; every query evaluated at a declared legal time; out-of-interval authority structurally unusable
R4 checked-temporal-consistency: cross-claim temporal coherence machine-checked; anachronistic derivations rejected fail-closed (H3)
R5 certified-bitemporal: legal time and knowledge time both tracked; every answer certified consistent at a stated (t_legal, t_knowledge) pair and replayable at that pair (H5,H8)
axis_lattices.delta_rule: Strict gap iff rank_A >= rank_B + 1 on this frozen ladder; evaluation-at-time claims (R3+) require re-runnable evidence at a past time point, else UNKNOWN.

rank_levels: R1 silent: contradictions, gaps, and uncertainty unreported
R2 heuristic-flagging: some conflicts flagged, no guarantee of surfacing
R3 typed-surfacing: contradiction, uncertainty, and typed UNKNOWN are first-class outputs; guessing structurally impossible (H2)
R4 coverage-accounted: machine-checked accounting of exactly what was examined vs not; enumerated blind-spot classes with per-answer status
R5 certified-frontier: every answer carries an offline re-checkable certificate delimiting the verified region, typing everything outside it UNKNOWN, with breach fail-closed (H3,H8)
axis_lattices.delta_rule: Strict gap iff rank_A >= rank_B + 1 on this frozen ladder; R4/R5 require the coverage accounting itself to be recomputable, not self-reported.

rank_levels: R1 no-falsification: no adversarial process exists
R2 manual-review: human review only, unstructured, at discretion
R3 systematic-adversarial-testing: pre-registered attack and mediocrity classes executed every cycle with tracked findings

R4 institutional-counter-design: independent adversarial agents with fresh context are an obligatory phase gate; every finding closed at its seat, refuted with proof, or registered with a retirement phase

R5 escalation-complete: falsification runs are themselves certified and replayable; any unresolved finding blocks admission fail-closed (H3); escalation to counter-design/redesign is a typed obligation, not a choice
axis_lattices.delta_rule: Strict gap iff rank_A >= rank_B + 1 on this frozen ladder; independence at R4+ must be structural (no access to implementer rationale), else the rank does not apply.

rank_levels: R1 best-effort-effects: tool/workflow side effects applied with no transaction concept
R2 manual-compensation: failures repaired by hand-written undo paths
R3 explicit-transactions: declared transaction boundaries with automatic rollback on failure
R4 all-or-nothing-enforced: atomicity machine-enforced across every workflow and external effect; partially-applied transitions structurally impossible (H6)
R5 certified-transactional-orchestration: every commit certificate-carrying in a monotonic sequence, offline replayable with zero producer trust (H5,H6,H8)
axis_lattices.delta_rule: Strict gap iff rank_A >= rank_B + 1 on this frozen ladder; R4+ requires evidence covering external (tool-side) effects, not only internal state — internal-only atomicity caps at R3.

rank_levels: R1 implicit-authority: anyone/anything can transition state
R2 unenforced-roles: authority documented but not mechanically checked
R3 capability-gated-transitions: every state transition requires a capability-checked authority under capability closure (H4); unauthorized attempts rejected fail-closed (H3)
R4 accountable-transitions: every transition is all-or-nothing and records the authorizing principal, basis, and certificate non-repudiably (H6)

R5 certified-governance: the authority model itself is formalized and verified; an unauthorized or review-skipping transition is structurally impossible, and review obligations are typed, blocking obligations
axis_lattices.delta_rule: Strict gap iff rank_A >= rank_B + 1 on this frozen ladder; ranks assigned only where enforcement is demonstrated on ALL transition classes, else the lowest class governs the rank.

rank_levels: R1 unauditable: no record from which decisions can be reconstructed
R2 logs-only: unstructured logs, reconstruction manual and lossy
R3 structured-audit-trail: typed, complete per-decision records linked to inputs
R4 deterministic-replay: full re-execution from recorded frozen inputs reproduces every trusted decision bit-for-bit (H5)
R5 zero-trust-offline-replay: a third party with no producer trust replays and recompute-and-compares the entire derivation chain offline (H8)
axis_lattices.delta_rule: Strict gap iff rank_A >= rank_B + 1 on this frozen ladder; a replay demonstration must include at least one decision from every trusted decision class, else UNKNOWN.

rank_levels: R1 uncontrolled: wall-clock, RNG, IO, and environment freely influence decisions
R2 best-effort-seeding: nondeterminism reduced procedurally (seeds, pinning) without guarantees
R3 declared-boundary: all nondeterministic inputs identified, typed, and quarantined outside the trusted path; crossings are explicit recorded events
R4 pure-trusted-derivations: trusted decisions are pure functions of frozen inputs — no wall-clock/RNG/IO in the decision by construction (H5)
R5 certified-purity: purity machine-verified end-to-end; nondeterminism in a trusted decision path is a type/build error, independently re-checkable
axis_lattices.delta_rule: Strict gap iff rank_A >= rank_B + 1 on this frozen ladder; R4/R5 require demonstration by divergence-free repeated replay under perturbed environments, not by policy assertion.

rank_levels: R1 volatile: committed state lost on crash
R2 periodic-persistence: snapshots with declared or undeclared loss windows
R3 write-ahead-durable: every committed transition durable before acknowledgment; recovery best-effort
R4 crash-consistent-atomic: recovery always reaches a consistent state containing exactly the committed transitions — no torn or partial transitions observable (H6)
R5 bounded-certified-recovery: recovery to the last certified state within a pre-declared bound, with the recovery procedure itself verified and its outcome replayable/checkable (H5,H8)
axis_lattices.delta_rule: Strict gap iff rank_A >= rank_B + 1 on this frozen ladder; R4+ requires evidence from injected-crash testing across transition classes; untested crash classes score UNKNOWN for the axis.

rank_levels: R1 no-liveness-claims: waits unbounded, hangs possible and silent
R2 heuristic-timeouts: timeouts exist but starvation and livelock unanalyzed
R3 typed-progress-obligations: operating model declared; every wait/blocking point typed with a progress obligation; starvation classes identified
R4 verified-liveness: progress proven under the declared operating model; on breach the system terminates fail-closed with a typed violation — it blocks, it never hangs silently (H3)
R5 certified-accountable-stall: liveness proofs offline re-checkable and any stall is itself a typed, surfaced, certificate-carrying state with an accountable cause
axis_lattices.delta_rule: Strict gap iff rank_A >= rank_B + 1 on this frozen ladder; liveness claims count only relative to the declared operating model frozen with the instrument, else UNKNOWN.

rank_levels: R1 uncharacterized: no latency model or bounds of any kind
R2 observed-only: empirical measurements exist but no committed characterization
R3 declared-complexity-class: per frozen-workload-class latency complexity/behavior class declared and pre-registered
R4 verified-class-bounds: declared classes derived and machine-checked from the architecture (algorithmic/structural analysis), not merely measured
R5 certified-worst-case-envelope: per-class worst-case envelope certified; envelope breach is a fail-closed typed violation, never silent degradation (H3)
axis_lattices.delta_rule: Class-level only at design stage: strict gap iff rank_A >= rank_B + 1 on this frozen ladder, or, within equal ranks >= R3, a strictly tighter declared/verified complexity class on the same frozen workload class. Numeric thresholds are deferred to the frozen benchmark and are NOT part of this instrument.
axis_lattices.quantitative_note: Quantitative axis. Design-stage comparison is by guarantee rank and complexity class only. Concrete latency numbers, percentiles, and workload distributions are frozen separately in the benchmark instrument before any candidate is measured; no number measured on a candidate may flow back into this ladder.

rank_levels: R1 uncharacterized: no throughput/scaling model
R2 observed-only: empirical throughput known, no committed scaling characterization
R3 declared-scaling-class: resource-normalized scaling class declared per frozen workload class (how throughput moves with resources and load)
R4 verified-scaling-bounds: scaling classes derived and machine-checked from the architecture, including identified saturation points

R5 certified-envelope-with-accountable-saturation: resource-normalized performance envelope certified; saturation and overload behavior fail-closed, typed, and accounted — never silent shedding or degradation (H3)
axis_lattices.delta_rule: Class-level only at design stage: strict gap iff rank_A >= rank_B + 1 on this frozen ladder, or, within equal ranks >= R3, a strictly better resource-normalized scaling class on the same frozen workload class. Numeric throughput targets are deferred to the frozen benchmark instrument.
axis_lattices.quantitative_note: Quantitative axis. Same regime as AX-17: ranks and scaling classes at design stage; numbers only via the separately frozen benchmark, resource-normalized, never retro-fitted to a candidate.

rank_levels: R1 opaque: no account of why a conclusion holds
R2 post-hoc-narrative: explanations generated after the fact, unverified against the actual decision process
R3 faithful-trace: explanations mechanically generated from the actual decision trace; nothing in the explanation absent from the trace
R4 inspectable-causal-account: every conclusion queryable down to admitted inputs; which-inputs-mattered and what-would-change questions answerable from the recorded derivation

R5 certified-explanation: the explanation is the proof/derivation object itself (or provably equivalent to it); divergence between explanation and decision is structurally impossible, and the account is offline re-checkable (H8)
axis_lattices.delta_rule: Strict gap iff rank_A >= rank_B + 1 on this frozen ladder; faithfulness at R3+ must be demonstrated by independent trace-vs-explanation comparison, not asserted.

rank_levels: R1 unmanaged-change: modifications without invariant or capability tracking
R2 versioned-releases: change is versioned but committed guarantees are not tracked as objects
R3 floor-regression-gated: committed capability floors and invariants encoded as blocking checks; a change that fails them cannot merge (H3)
R4 monotone-admission: evolution steps are admitted transitions — a machine check proves no committed floor is lowered before admission (H6,H7)
R5 certified-evolution: every evolution step carries an offline re-checkable proof of invariant preservation and capability monotonicity across the whole committed floor set (H7,H8)
axis_lattices.delta_rule: Strict gap iff rank_A >= rank_B + 1 on this frozen ladder; R3+ requires the floor set to be explicit, frozen, and complete over all committed guarantees — an implicit or partial floor set caps the rank at R2.

rank_levels: R1 informal-design: prose documents only, no machine-checked properties
R2 reviewed-specs: structured specifications, human-verified only
R3 machine-checked-spec-properties: core invariants (including H1-H8 as applicable) formalized and machine-proven at the specification level
R4 verified-spec-to-source: refinement from architecture specification to source machine-checked, so the source provably implements the proven spec

R5 end-to-end-transport: the full chain specification -> source -> executable is verified (verified compilation, translation validation, or equivalent), and the whole chain is third-party re-checkable with zero producer trust (H8)
axis_lattices.delta_rule: Strict gap iff rank_A >= rank_B + 1 on this frozen ladder; a rank applies only to the extent the verified perimeter covers the trusted path — a trusted-path component outside the perimeter caps the axis one rank lower.

rank_levels: R1 single-order-hardcoded: one legal order's structure baked into the mechanism
R2 ad-hoc-parameterization: other legal orders reachable only via per-order code changes or patches
R3 declared-order-abstraction: all order-specific content isolated as data behind a typed legal-order interface; the mechanism contains no order-specific logic by design
R4 demonstrated-multi-order: at least two structurally distinct legal orders instantiated with zero mechanism change, with the zero-change claim independently verified
R5 certified-generality: the mechanism is proven parametric over a formalized legal-order signature; instantiating a new order is data admission only, and the proof is offline re-checkable (H8)
axis_lattices.delta_rule: Strict gap iff rank_A >= rank_B + 1 on this frozen ladder; 'structurally distinct' at R4 is pre-registered (different hierarchy-of-norms and temporal-effect structure), so a candidate cannot choose conveniently similar orders.

verdict_schema: TournamentVerdict := an ordered set of exactly 22 AxisVerdict records, one per axis, and NOTHING else — the schema deliberately contains NO aggregate, total, score, weight, count-of-wins, or overall-winner field, so compensation across axes is structurally impossible (there is no place to write it). AxisVerdict := { axis_id: enum{AX-01..AX-22} (required, unique across the record set); winner: enum{A, B, TIE, UNKNOWN, INCOMPARABLE} (required; TIE only when rank_a and rank_b are both KNOWN and equal; A or B only when both ranks KNOWN and the gap satisfies the axis delta_rule — a KNOWN gap smaller than the delta_rule is TIE-with-noted-gap in justification, not a win; UNKNOWN whenever either rank is UNKNOWN, per unknown_rule; INCOMPARABLE only for the evidence-type conflict case defined in incomparable_rule); rank_a: enum over the axis's frozen rank_levels, or the literal UNKNOWN (required; never null, never a number outside the frozen ladder); rank_b: same domain (required); justification: string (required; must state, for each assigned rank, which frozen ladder criterion the evidence satisfies and, for a win, which delta_rule clause the gap meets — restating conclusions without ladder reference is invalid); evidence_refs: non-empty array of content-addressed references to frozen, third-party-recomputable evidence artifacts (required even for UNKNOWN, where it references the attempted-and-failed verification record; H8: a reference to a producer's self-declaration is not admissible evidence) }. Global dominance is never stored: it is recomputed by any reader as the pure conjunction over the 22 records per order_definition (all-axes >= with at least one delta-satisfying strict gap and zero UNKNOWN/INCOMPARABLE records). A verdict set with any UNKNOWN or INCOMPARABLE record cannot ground elimination of the disadvantaged candidate (H2, H3); it grounds the obligations in unknown_rule / incomparable_rule instead.
termination_rule: The tournament terminates SUCCESSFULLY only when BOTH conditions hold simultaneously: (T1) two consecutive FULL rounds — each round being a complete pass in which every active challenger-generation mechanism (adversarial designers, counter-design agents, synthesis obligations from incomparable_rule, and reopened-UNKNOWN resolutions) runs to completion against the current front — end with ZERO surviving challengers: every generated challenger was either strictly dominated per order_definition with a complete 22-axis verdict set containing no UNKNOWN and no INCOMPARABLE record, or was merged via a discharged synthesis obligation; AND (T2) an independent completeness critic (fresh context, no access to the front's design rationale, per the internal-adversary protocol) certifies, with its search procedure itself recorded and replayable (H5), that zero unexplored challenger CLASSES remain — i.e., every pre-registered generation class over the 22 axes and H1-H8 has been instantiated and adjudicated, and the critic could construct no new class. No cap of any kind — round count, wall-clock time, token/compute budget, agent count, or organizer decision — may substitute for T1+T2 or authorize declaring a winner: caps bound effort, never confer success. If any budget or externally imposed limit is exhausted before T1 and T2 both hold, the mandatory outcome is TOURNAMENT_INCOMPLETE — a typed, fail-closed terminal state (H3) that records the surviving front, all open UNKNOWNs, all undischarged synthesis obligations, and the last completeness-critic report, and that expressly does NOT crown any candidate supreme. Any open UNKNOWN axis on a front member, or any undischarged INCOMPARABLE synthesis obligation, is itself a surviving challenger for T1 purposes: the tournament cannot terminate successfully around it. Termination status is a derived, recomputable fact from the round records (H8), never a declaration.
unknown_rule: UNKNOWN is a first-class typed rank value (H2), assigned on an axis whenever no independently re-checkable evidence (H8) establishes any frozen rank for a candidate — including when evidence exists but is producer-declared only, partial over the axis's required coverage, or non-recomputable. Effects, all fail-closed (H3): (1) UNKNOWN blocks comparison — an AxisVerdict with either rank UNKNOWN has winner=UNKNOWN, and no pairwise >=_T, >_T, TIE, or equality conclusion may issue for the pair while any of its 22 records is UNKNOWN. (2) UNKNOWN never upgrades — it is never treated as equality, as a pass, as 'presumed at least rank R1', or as resolved by time, repetition, majority of assessors, or organizer decision; the ONLY exit from UNKNOWN is new frozen, recomputable evidence establishing a definite rank, adjudicated in a subsequent round. (3) UNKNOWN blocks elimination and success both ways — a candidate is never eliminated on the strength of an opponent's UNKNOWN axis, and never advanced past one of its own: each UNKNOWN spawns a typed resolution obligation (what evidence would decide the rank, and by which ladder criterion) that counts as a surviving challenger under termination_rule T1. (4) UNKNOWN propagates — any derived fact computed over an UNKNOWN input (including the global dominance conjunction) is itself UNKNOWN, never defaulted. (5) UNKNOWN is evidenced — the verdict's evidence_refs must reference the attempted verification and its failure mode, so third parties can recompute that UNKNOWN was the correct assignment (H8).
incomparable_rule: INCOMPARABLE arises in exactly two frozen situations, and in neither may it be dropped, averaged over, or resolved by judgment call. (S1) Pairwise incomparability under >=_T: candidate A is strictly better than B on at least one axis and strictly worse on at least one other (all involved ranks KNOWN). Because the order is non-compensatory, neither dominates — and the mandatory consequence is a SYNTHESIS OBLIGATION: a typed, tracked requirement to construct a synthesis candidate C whose target profile is, per axis, at least max(rank_A, rank_B), or to produce a recorded impossibility argument (itself adjudicated as a challenger artifact) showing why the maxima conflict structurally on identified axes. Until discharged — by C entering the tournament as a first-class challenger, or by the impossibility argument surviving adversarial review — the obligation counts as a surviving challenger under termination_rule T1; neither A nor B may be eliminated in favor of the other, and the pair may not be silently carried as 'both fine'. Discharged impossibility arguments are frozen into the record so the completeness critic can verify the frontier's shape (H8). (S2) Within-axis rank incomparability: assessors find KNOWN evidence for A and B on the same axis that satisfies different, non-nested ladder criteria such that neither rank_A >= rank_B nor rank_B >= rank_A is derivable from the frozen ladder text. This is a defect of the instrument, not of the candidates: the AxisVerdict records winner=INCOMPARABLE, and the mandatory consequence is a LATTICE-REFINEMENT OBLIGATION — the axis ladder is refined (splitting or reordering ranks) by the instrument-freezing authority, the refinement is version-stamped, pre-registered before further use, and ALL prior verdicts on that axis are invalidated and re-adjudicated under the refined ladder, so no verdict ever rests on an ambiguous ladder. Both obligation types are append-only tracked to closure; a tournament with any open incomparability obligation cannot satisfy termination_rule T1 (H3).
